title: Rubin returns to early LSST survey operations after storm and maintenance
detail: Observatory announced on Nov 9 that it is back in early survey operations mode, the configuration used before the storm and planned maintenance. Engineering test sets will be interleaved with LSST observations, with configuration changes to follow from test results. The team ran the pre-storm configuration to confirm performance was restored.

media.caption: Rubin is back to the LSST announcement
